SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4726
Date 11 / 4 / 33

Labour

Local Tailors - strike ended

The strike of the tailors of the modern tailoring
shops in the Louza District came to an end this morning,
April 11, when all resumed in consequence of the following
decisions reached at a meeting held by about 100 tailors in
the General Labour Union, 117 Poh Yeu Road, between 5.30
and 8.15 p.m. April 10 :-

1. That work be resumed on April 11 and that employers be
urged to abide by the agreement reached on April 7
(Vide I.M. 8/4/33).

2. That the Chinese Authorities be requested to instruct
shops not to reduce the workers' wages, and reinstate
the workers recently dismissed from some of the shops.

3. That a petition be submitted to the Chinese Authorities
applying for assistance in urging the employers to come
to some agreement governing working conditions.

Chinese Cotton Mills - owners decide on partial
suspension of operations

Thirty six representatives of cotton mill owners
in Shanghai as well as out ports held a meeting in the
Cotton Stock Exchange Building, 80 Avenue Edward VII
between 5.30 and 7 p.m. April 10 when Yung Tsong-ching
(榮宗敬), owner of the Sung Sing Cotton Mills, presided.
The following resolutions were discussed and passed :-

1. That work on Saturdays and Sundays be suspended in
Chinese mills for the period between April 23 and
May 21 owing to trade depression.

2. That any member of the Cotton Mill Owners' Association
who ignores this decision be fined or otherwise
punished.

3. That the staff employees of mills be paid half wages
for the days of suspension of operations.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 D 4726
日期 1933年4月11日

劳工

本地裁缝——罢工结束

劳合区（Louza District）现代服装店的裁缝罢工于今晨（4月11日）结束，所有人员均恢复工作。此结果源于约100名裁缝于4月10日下午5时30分至8时15分在波阳路117号总工会举行的会议上达成的以下决定：

1. 于4月11日复工，并敦促雇主遵守4月7日达成的协议（参见1933年4月8日情报备忘录）。

2. 请求中国当局指令各店铺不得降低工人工资，并复职近期被部分店铺解雇的工人。

3. 向中国当局提交请愿书，请求协助敦促雇主就管辖工作条件达成某种协议。

华资棉纺厂——厂主决定部分停工

4月10日下午5时30分至7时，上海及外埠的36位棉纺厂业主代表在爱多亚路80号棉花交易所大楼举行会议，由申新纺织厂厂主荣宗敬主持。会议讨论并通过以下决议：

1. 鉴于市面萧条，华资工厂在4月23日至5月21日期间，暂停周六和周日的工作。

2. 凡棉纺厂业主协会成员无视此决定者，将处以罚款或其他惩罚。

3. 停工期间，工厂职员发放半薪。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4726
Date 11 / 4 / 33

April 11, 1933.    Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE BICYCLE SHOPS IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION.

As a protest against the levy of a licence
on bicycle repairing shops by the French Municipal Council,
about 50 Bicycle Repairing and Hiring Shops have
suspended business for 5 days.
At 2 p.m. yesterday, representatives of all
the shops held a meeting at their Association at the corner
of Ningpo and Fokien Roads at which the following measures
were brought up for discussion:-
1. That two representatives be detailed to open
negotiations with the French Municipal Council.
2. That a manifesto asking the public for assistance
be issued.
3. That an Appeal be made to the local Tangpu and
other political organs to open negotiations with the
French Municipal Council over the restoration of the water
and electric service and the payment of the losses sustained
during the period of disconnection.
4. That shops engaged in the same line of business
be notified to be firm and to await a settlement.
5. That investigation be made into the losses during
the period of disconnection.
6. That, if no satisfactory result be reached, all
shops unanimously close their business.
Shortly after 5 p.m. yesterday, representatives
of the Bicycle Repairing and Hiring Shops Association
submitted an appeal to the Shanghai Second Special District
Citizens Federation for assistance. They were advised
to await a settlement.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

MODERN DRESS MAKERS TO RESUME OPERATIONS.

About 110 workers attended a general meeting
held by the Tailors Union at 2 p.m. yesterday in the premises
of the General Labour Union at which representatives of
the local Tangpu and the General Labour Union were also
in attendance.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That the strikers resume operations on the
morning of April 11.
2. That a petition be submitted to the local Tangpu
to deal with the Ching Tai Ziang Dress Making Shop for
violation of the decisions passed.
3. That a settlement of the dispute over the demands
according to law be awaited.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 D 4726
日期 1933年4月11日

1933年4月11日。上午译件。

劳工。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

法租界的自行车行。

为抗议法公董局对自行车修理店征收执照费，约50家自行车修理及租赁店已停业5天。
昨日下午2时，各家店铺代表在宁波路与福建路拐角处的同业公会举行会议，会上提出讨论以下措施：
1. 指派两名代表与法公董局展开谈判。
2. 发布宣言，请求公众援助。
3. 向本地党部及其他政治机关呼吁，就恢复水电供应及赔偿断供期间所受损失一事，与法公董局展开谈判。
4. 通知同行坚定立场，等待解决。
5. 调查断供期间的损失。
6. 若未能取得满意结果，所有店铺一致停业。
昨日下午5时许，自行车修理及租赁业同业公会代表向上海第二特区市民联合会提交求助申请。获建议等待解决。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

现代裁缝将复工。

约110名工人参加了昨日下午2时在总工会会址举行的裁缝工会大会，本地党部及总工会代表亦出席会议。
会议通过以下决议：
1. 罢工者于4月11日上午复工。
2. 向本地党部提交请愿书，要求处理景泰祥（Ching Tai Ziang，音译）服装店违反所通过决议的行为。
3. 等待依法解决有关诉求的争议。
